access.other_controls: Ctrl+L remains Mail; prior conflicting leaderboard defaults migrate automatically while custom bindings are preserved.

implemented: Silver, raised gold and bronze podium cards
Five generated artwork assets: painted metal portrait wreaths, textured champion panels and a midnight-blue battlement backdrop
Real character portraits from saved appearance and worn equipment, including offline players
One shared 256x256 portrait bake stage and a 32-entry in-memory cache keyed by appearance; no continuous per-card rendering
Top-ten table with highlighted self row
Actual personal rank beyond the top ten
Refresh, loading, empty, offline and timeout states
Request IDs reject stale or dismissed responses
Window stacking, dragging, shortcut rebinding and viewport resize handling
Capability-gated structured server snapshot and legacy chat fallback
Large XP totals encoded as decimal strings
Curriculum accepts the leaderboard window's read request

client.result: PASS in headless and rendered runs; full main scene HUD button, window stack, Escape, Ctrl+Shift+L Leaderboards, Ctrl+L Mail, and shortcut-default migration checked. Portrait rendering covers ten sample players, cache reuse and all 16 creation options.

rendered_preview.result: Inspected full-client 1280x800 preview with synthetic scores and runtime character portraits; all ten ranks and personal highlight visible.

legacy_protocol.result: Leaderboard capability probe passes; suite reports 14 failures in other existing capability, actor-anchor and legacy-artwork checks

validation.diagnostics: Full-client render exits with existing scene UID fallback warnings and two cached texture release warnings at shutdown.

limitations: Portraits use the actual game character models and saved appearance. Unsupported or unavailable appearances use initials.
Existing category scoring behavior is preserved, including the previously identified missing gameplay update for the summoning_kills counter.
Updated client and server are required for the graphical leaderboard. No public deployment or release was performed.

portraits.server: One bounded query reads only public actor type, appearance and worn visual IDs for the ten visible players; no full Character loads or private player records are sent.
portraits.client: The current runtime character models supply race, hair, colours and worn equipment. A shared offscreen stage renders each new appearance once; cached textures are reused across rows and categories.
portraits.fallback: Initials remain visible while a portrait loads or when appearance is unavailable. Cache and pending work clear on disconnect.
portraits.sample_data: Preview uses ten invented players in godot-client/tests/fixtures/leaderboards_portraits.json. The first three sample players have no headgear to show their hairstyles.
